title: RICoT: Recurrent Interleaved Chain-of-Thought for Page Stream Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2611.22382v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have renewed interest in Page Stream Segmentation (PSS), splitting a multi-page file into its constituent documents. Yet published LLM methods still frame the task as boundary classification over one or a few neighboring pages, and commercial document-splitting APIs do not disclose their methods. We reimagine PSS for LLMs as a sequential process over the whole stream and propose RICoT (Recurrent Interleaved Chain-of-Thought), a prompting framework that works through the pages as a reader would: within a sliding window it reasons about each page and commits its boundary decision before moving on, and across windows it carries forward a compact record of what it has read, keeping per-call cost bounded. We also introduce FinancePSS-205, a benchmark of 205 real-world, de-identified financial page streams, to be released publicly. translated_title: RICoT：用于页面流分割的循环交错思维链
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）重新激发了人们对页面流分割（Page Stream Segmentation, PSS）的兴趣，该任务是将多页文件拆分为其组成的文档。然而，已发表的LLM方法仍然将该任务框架化为对一页或少数相邻页面的边界分类，而商业文档拆分API也不公开其方法。我们重新构想了面向LLM的PSS任务，将其视为对整个页面流的顺序处理过程，并提出了RICoT（循环交错思维链，Recurrent Interleaved Chain-of-Thought），这是一个像读者一样逐页处理文档的提示框架：在滑动窗口内，它对每一页进行推理并先做出边界决策再继续往下读；在窗口之间，它携带一个已读内容的紧凑记录，从而使每次调用的成本保持有界。我们还介绍了FinancePSS-205，一个包含205个真实世界、去标识化金融页面流的基准数据集，并将公开发布。在FinancePSS-205上，RICoT匹配或超越了成对（pairwise）和窗口化（windowed）提示方法的表现（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出RICoT循环交错思维链提示框架，首次将页面流分割重新构想为对整个流的顺序处理过程，像读者一样在滑动窗口内逐页推理并携带已读内容的紧凑记录以控制成本，同时发布了包含205个真实金融页面流的FinancePSS-205基准数据集。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes RICoT, a Recurrent Interleaved Chain-of-Thought prompting framework that reimagines page stream segmentation as a sequential whole-stream process—reasoning page-by-page within sliding windows while carrying forward a compact reading record to keep per-call cost bounded—and introduces FinancePSS-205, a benchmark of 205 real-world financial page streams.
